name: Ui_MessageWindow_SubDtor
summary: Deleting destructor of a message-window variant: installs vtable 0x0076AAAC, releases the sub-widget at +0x138, releases three layout references, runs Ui_Object_DtorBase, unlinks lists and destroys the trailing sub-object.
evidence: Callees Ui_Widget_ReleaseSub, Ui_LayoutRef_Release, Ui_Object_DtorBase confirm message-window sub-object teardown; vtable 0x0076AAAC and neighbour Ui_MessageWindow2_CtorB support the class.

name: maybe_Field_ActorAction_CtorAlt
summary: Constructor of a field-action subclass: allocates via Actor_Action_InitDescriptor and installs vtable 0x0076AEEC, differing from the base only in slot +0x10.
evidence: Only two stores; the overriding slot 0x003E4008 is unnamed, so the subclass identity cannot be stated.

name: maybe_Field_ClimbAction_SyncCameraToAnimSpeed
summary: Reads the player actor's animation speed multiplier and writes it as a float onto the camera sub-object at f_B8->f_FC so the camera follows the climb animation speed.
evidence: Vtable 0x76B0D8 confirms the climb action class; callee Field_GetActorAnimSpeedMultiplier and the float setter at f_FC support the sync, but the setter is unnamed.

name: maybe_Field_Object2D_SyncAttachedNodes
summary: Per-frame positioner for 2D nodes/light attached to an object: computes the owner transform (or rotates the local offset by the owner quaternion), writes node positions only when changed, and repeats for every child node.
evidence: Quaternion helpers and child accessors remain unnamed; reached only through a vtable, so the class/verb cannot be pinned.

name: Ui_List_SelectByValue
summary: Selects the row containing a given byte value: in two-column mode scans the 14-entry byte table at record+0x40, computes row/column with divide-by-5 and selects via Ui_List_SelectEntryById, then clamps the scroll window to 5 rows.
evidence: Callee Ui_List_SelectEntryById and sole caller Ui_SmithMenu_HandleCommand support 'select row containing value'; body damaged around the 64-bit division.

name: maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesThumb
signature: u32 maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesThumb(u32 scene, void* unit, u32 abilityId, u32 ctx)
summary: Thumb implementation of the ability validation loop: walks the unit's ability list and reports whether the requested ability id is present and usable.
evidence: Decompilation carries unaff_r4 and lost register mapping; only loop shape matches BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilities.

name: maybe_Ui_AnimSequence_UpdateChildren
signature: void maybe_Ui_AnimSequence_UpdateChildren(AnimOwner* self, u32 forwarded, u32 forwarded2)
summary: Drives child animation delegates between self+0x278 and +0x280: on state change calls their +0x24 reset or +0x28 update virtuals, restarts the current step on child completion, and finishes with 0x003F7718.
evidence: Vtable 0x00780A48 slot 0 is this address but the owner class is unidentified and 0x001BBC0C/0x003F7718 are unnamed.

name: maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesC
signature: u32 maybe_BattleScene_CheckUnitAbilitiesC(u32 scene, int index, int entries)
summary: Ability validation loop reading entry IDs and querying Pack_HandleChain_IsReleased.
evidence: Calls 0x00604430 and 0x001BBC0C but decompilation contains unaff_r4..r9; damaged body keeps maybe_ at <=0.3.

name: Field_SceneObjectCtor_vt773258
summary: Constructor of a 0x28C-byte field scene object: allocates, installs vtable 0x00773258, presets state fields, constructs the embedded sprite at +0x5C and clears the id bytes; used as the object-table factory hook by Field_Scene_InitObjectTable.
evidence: Only caller is Field_Scene_InitObjectTable; callee Field_SceneObjectSprite_Ctor builds the embedded sprite; vtable 0x00773258 installed.

name: Ui_List_DtorWithArray
summary: Non-deleting destructor of a list widget: installs vtable 0x00782EE8, relinks the intrusive sentinel, clears the counter, copies the default timing block and destroys the four 0x1C4-byte rows.
evidence: Only caller is Menu_HorseRace_DeletingDtor; std_destroy_range over 4 elements of 0x1C4 with element routine 0x00411F24; sentinel relink and vtable install.

name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CtorPaneB
summary: Minimal constructor stub of the tactics-window family: Ui_Object_CtorBase plus vtable 0x773FE8, no other field init; paired with dtor 0x00479B94.
evidence: Only caller Ui_SakusenWindow_Ctor; vtable 0x00773FE8 with sibling dtor in same block; body is just base ctor + vtable store.

name: maybe_Casino_Slot_UpdateSpeed
summary: Body is damaged: it calls the casino gimmick context installer, then contains a garbled lazy-init of the game work and a float computation stored to self->reelSpinSpeed and work+0x2E1E4; callers are unrelated (PartyStatus_LoadNewestRecord, Event_ApplyScenarioJumpSettings).
evidence: Ghidra shows in_fpscr and a bogus lazy-init block; callers unrelated to casino; only the callee 0x004AC328 and work+0x2E1E4 write tie it to the casino family.

name: Ui_SakusenWindow_CtorSlotWidget
summary: Constructor of a tactics-window slot widget: shared Ui_Object constructor, class vtable 0x776E00 and default slot type 0x0B at +0x49.
evidence: Only caller Ui_SakusenWindow_Ctor; vtable 0x00776E00; explicit type byte 0x0B at +0x49.

name: Ui_BattleTargetMarker_Ctor_vt777B60
summary: Constructor of the battle target marker UI object: Ui_Screen_CtorWithTextCache plus vtable 0x00777B60, initializes the marker sub-object at +0xC9D (zero vector, flags) and the -1 id at +0xC98.
evidence: Installs g_uiBattleTargetMarkerVtable; callee Ui_BattleTargetMarker_CreateFromModelId and 0x002689E8 build the marker sub-object; caller Field_ObjectFactory_Kind03.

name: Ui_UmaWindow_DeletingDtor2
summary: Deleting-destructor wrapper for the second horse-race window vtable: runs Ui_UmaWindow_Dtor_2 then operator delete.
evidence: Vtable 0x0077A104 slot 0 beside named Ui_UmaWindow_InitTextPanels/Update; calls Ui_UmaWindow_Dtor_2 then 0x0010F6CC (operator delete).

name: maybe_Event_Gimmick_UpdateOffset
summary: State-2 update of an event-gimmick offset animation: decays f_38 by 0.8 per call, writes the remaining offset into the sampled node's +0x9C, and once it is <= 0.5 samples the node transform and advances the state byte f_2C to 3.
evidence: Sibling slot 4 (0x004F0EA0) is the state-3 poll of the same f_2C machine; constants 0x3F4CCCCD (0.8) and ~0.5; no callers, so the family is inferred from vtable 0x0077C404 neighbours.

name: maybe_Event_Gimmick_UpdateState3
summary: State-3 step of the event-gimmick offset-animation state machine: samples the transform via 0x003DCC3C and advances the state byte f_2C from 3 to 4 once the sampled result code at f_45 reads 3.
evidence: Void state-machine step (no return value used; callee 0x003DCC3C is called for its side effect on paramState, not for a predicate result), so the 'CheckDone' predicate name is wrong; it is the state-3 continuation of 0x004F0D98, vtable slot 4 of 0x0077C404 next to Event_Gimmick_Constructor. No named callers, so the subsystem prefix stays generic.

name: Fs_Object_ReadChunk
signature: unsigned char* Fs_Object_ReadChunk(void* object, void* reader, unsigned offset, unsigned arg4, int size, unsigned arg6, unsigned arg7)
summary: Null/zero-safe chunked read: rejects null object/reader or zero size with nn::Result 0xE0E046BC, simulates read latency, then forwards to the reader's virtual read slot +4.
evidence: Sole caller is named Fs_Object_ReadAll; callee Fs_SimulateReadLatency; forwards to (*reader+4) virtual read.

name: Svc_Object_Dtor
summary: Base destructor of the service-object protocol: installs the class vtable, flushes a pending buffered handle via Svc_Ipc_Send080E0080, then clears session/buffer/handle words.
evidence: Writes class vtable 0x780EF0 then zeroes members; calls Svc_Ipc_Send080E0080 and Svc_Object_GetFactoryChecked; only entry writing the vtable itself.

name: maybe_Ui_IconCache_BeginWrite
signature: unsigned int maybe_Ui_IconCache_BeginWrite(void* self, int arg2, unsigned int size)
summary: Begins a cache-block write: validates aligned size in 0x70..0x18000, opens/validates the cache index, records size and pointer, and computes total block size from directory entries.
evidence: Caller Svc_WaitReadyAndSendRequest also calls Ui_IconCache_ResetHeader; callee 0x0050D864 cache-current check; size bounds and entry-table walk.

name: maybe_Container_HashMap_LookupBySlot
signature: void* maybe_Container_HashMap_LookupBySlot(void* self, unsigned int ignored, unsigned int slot)
summary: Looks up the record owning key slot in the two-table container: small-table mode returns the packed word at self+0x21C+slot*4, otherwise builds the key and linear-probes buckets at self+0x3CC.
evidence: Callees std_String_InitFrom and 0x00658C38 bucket key compare; two-table layout with slot bounds checks.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_ApplyScrollOffset
signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_ApplyScrollOffset(int self, float* scroll, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int dataKey)
summary: Called from the battle UI scroll-animation update: resolves a data record from dataKey, negates the y scroll component and re-derives the target widget's coordinates from base values plus scroll offsets.
evidence: Sole caller Battle_Ui_UpdateScrollAnimation; writes target+0x64/+0x68 from f_80/f_84 plus scroll; calls Game_GetDataManager.

name: maybe_std_InitStaticArray
summary: Compiler-generated static initialiser: default-constructs an 8-element array of 4-byte elements from type descriptor 0x005906C0 in a stack buffer; Ghidra marks the constructor non-returning so the rest is unrecoverable.
evidence: Only callee std_ConstructArray with type 0x005906C0, 8 elements of 4 bytes; callers are unrelated UI paths.

name: maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_State_Ctor
signature: void maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_State_Ctor(u8* self, u32 arg2, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Constructor of a small state block used by the recipe-book/title-demo screens: sets state byte 1, id word -1, two 0xFF sentinels, then constructs three 4-byte elements of type 0x00192580 at +0xA.
evidence: Caller maybe_Ui_RecipeBook_Ctor; element type 0x00192580 shared with party-stat code; sentinel init pattern.

name: maybe_Field2D_MapChip_WalkDirectionThumbA
signature: void maybe_Field2D_MapChip_WalkDirectionThumbA(char* grid, u32* outCollision, u32 x, u32 y)
summary: Four-byte Thumb entry that falls through into the shared 0x005BEF5A collision-step walker with direction register 0; walks candidate chips, calls Field2D_MapChip_CheckCollisionStep and copies 0xD-byte step records.
evidence: No callers, damaged decompilation (unaff_r6/r7/r10, in_stack_* pseudolocals); only the shared walker and Field2D_MapChip_CheckCollisionStep are trustworthy, the A/B direction split is an interpretation.

name: maybe_Field2D_MapChip_WalkDirectionThumbB
signature: void maybe_Field2D_MapChip_WalkDirectionThumbB(char* grid, u32* outCollision, u32 x, u32 y)
summary: Second four-byte Thumb entry into the same 0x005BEF5A collision-step walker; walks candidate chips, records collision steps and finishes through the actor's vtable +0x40.
evidence: Same damaged body and same two named callees as 0x005BEF52; the four bytes of entry code that distinguish A from B are not visible in the C and there is no caller.

name: Field2D_SpriteNode_InitFromParams
signature: int Field2D_SpriteNode_InitFromParams(u32* self, int* arg2, int arg3, u32* params)
summary: Initialises a 2D sprite node from a parameter block: installs vtable 0x00783870, copies three parameter words, derives position via Gfx_Actor_SetPositionXY, stores a 40.0f scale and attaches the sprite handle.
evidence: Caller is the named Field2D_Sprite_SetRotation and the position helper Gfx_Actor_SetPositionXY is named; vtable install plus parameter copy and 0x42A00000 (40.0f) constant support the sprite-node init reading.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_UpdatePathMotion
summary: Advances a gimmick along its path: steps the phase, clamps it against the arc-length table, sets the finished byte, then writes the sampled position/tangent into the caller's frame record.
evidence: Both path readers are now confident (Field_Path_GetPosition, Field_Path_GetTangent) and Math_MatrixInverse is called for the frame, but there is no caller and the sample-write half is still inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_Trail_ClampProgress
summary: Trail update step: fetches the curve/sample array through the object's vtable +0x70, clamps the two progress floats, writes the clamped progress and rebinds the trail animator.
evidence: Caller is the named Gfx_Trail_UpdateFollowPath, but the body contains bad instruction data, a coprocessor_function pseudo-call and unaff_r5, so the clamping reading is only a hypothesis.

name: Field_NpcActionBehavior_Ctor
signature: void* Field_NpcActionBehavior_Ctor(void* mem, void* parent, void* def, const char* name, int flags)
summary: Constructor of the NPC-action behaviour object: base-constructs through Gfx_ObjectDesc_Ctor4, installs vtable 0x0077FE30 and sets the default interval 0.26f at +0x2C.
evidence: Caller Field_SetupNpcActionScript passes the full (buffer, parent, def, name, flags) tuple; vtable 0x0077FE30 sits in the same family as Field_NpcMimicAction_Ctor and Monster_AiBehavior_Ctor, and 0x3E851EB8 is 0.26f.

name: maybe_Battle_Actor_SelectStateMessageRow
summary: Selects one of four battle-state ids for the actor's member by priority (0x29/0x2A/0x27/0x28, each tested through virtual +0xE8) and fetches the corresponding data-manager row with 0x0063E05C.
evidence: Body is a priority switch over the four vtable ids plus a 0x0063E05C data-row fetch; the fetched row may be returned (Ghidra drops it) and there is no caller, so the name stays tentative.

name: maybe_Casino_Slot_InitReelStrip
summary: Constructs a 27-element array of 4-byte elements (element constructor 0x005F9720) in the caller's stack frame; the only caller Casino_Slot_BuildSpinResult consumes it as one reel strip.
evidence: Caller is the named Casino_Slot_BuildSpinResult, fixing the casino context, but the function only performs std_ConstructArray(..., 0x005F9720, 4, 0x1B) and reads no reel constant or symbol, so 'reel strip' remains an interpretation.

name: maybe_Casino_Slot_InitPaytable
summary: Zeroes a small header with 0xFF sentinels and constructs a three-element array via std_ConstructArray; the body is truncated and reads no paytable constant, so the payout role is unproven.
evidence: Only caller is Casino_Slot_BuildSpinResult; callees include Casino_Slot_PickLosingStop/PickMatchingStop and Math_WeightedRandomIndexDefaultRng, but the visible body never dereferences the array and the 912-byte size does not match the few lines shown.

name: maybe_Gfx_SpritePane_FindMaterialValueByName
summary: Looks up a layout object by name through the manager vtable slot +0x2C, verifies it against the sprite-pane vtable, and returns the primary material's +0x78 word (0 when absent).
evidence: Caller Ui_PokerWindow_ResolveCardObjects passes a name string; callee Gfx_SpritePane_GetPrimaryMaterial; vtable 0x007AE8A4 checked; what +0x78 means is still unknown.

name: maybe_Gfx_GpuState_WriteMaterialColor
summary: Emits the material/colour GPU state: converts float colours and light-scale values to PICA 21-bit float and appends them with material/texture-env/light register writes to the command buffer.
evidence: Only caller Gfx_GpuState_Invalidate dispatches here for the material/colour dirty bit; body writes 0x000F0041/0x000F0043 etc. into the command buffer; individual register meanings partly inferred.

name: maybe_Gfx_GpuState_SyncTextureStage
summary: Synchronises cached texture-stage state: compares the render node's resource pointers with the cached ones and emits the 0x000F011x/0x000F006E register pairs when they differ.
evidence: Caller Gfx_GpuState_Invalidate (dirty-bit 0x100 writer); body keeps one pointer in in_r3/unaff_r7 and FP status in in_fpscr, so the cache comparison is only partly reconstructed.

name: maybe_Gfx_GpuState_BuildLightingBlock
signature: void maybe_Gfx_GpuState_BuildLightingBlock(void* self, u32 dirtyBits, u32 mode, u32* out)
summary: Large GPU-state rebuild routine emitting viewport/scissor/window, texture-binding, light/lighting and shader-constant register writes into the command buffer for the given dirty bits.
evidence: Only named caller Gfx_GpuState_Invalidate; 3454-byte body heavily damaged (unaff_r6/r7/r9, in_cr*, overlapping instructions), so the 'lighting' focus is only one part of a multi-block writer.

name: maybe_Ui_ListWindow_WrapRow
signature: void maybe_Ui_ListWindow_WrapRow(void* self, int delta, u32 arg3, int wrap)
summary: Adds delta to the list's current row index (+0x4C) and, when the result goes negative and wrap is set, wraps it back into range using the item count from vtable +0x64.
evidence: Callers Ui_SakusenWindow_Confirm and Ui_ScrollBar_Update only show cursor movement; body ends in three halt_baddata sites and an indirect call through address 0, so the upper clamp is lost.
